name: atendime
description: Read a service business's catalog and funnel stages on atendi.me.

interface.longDescription: atendi.me connects your agent to a service business's catalog and sales funnel on atendi.me, built for barbershops, clinics, salons and studios in Brazil. Read the active services and products with their category, amount in centavos, duration in the schedule and availability, and read the ordered funnel stages without exposing customer contacts or conversations. All tools are read-only.
capabilities: List active services and products in the business catalog
Check appointment duration and availability per catalog item
List the ordered stages of the sales funnel
defaultPrompt: List the services and products in my atendi.me catalog.
Which items in my atendi.me catalog are currently available?
What are the stages of my funnel on atendi.me?
